items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth; blocked for new public launches, monetization expansion, and security-sensitive exposure. Recommend retaining the two live-site improvements as unclaimed, capacity-gated queue work only. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; open findings include banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms gaps. Analytics and SEO telemetry are available for measured sites, but incomplete telemetry alone is not a growth blocker. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking_id other; site-attributed income, ROI, margin, and causal lift are unsupported. Security and operations sweeps have no results. Exact decision: do not execute either change until CTO reconciles capacity and releases one slot by 2026-10-01T18:00Z; preserve no-spend, no-credential, no-dependency, no-configuration, no-tracking, no-cross-site, disclosure, consent, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and rollback boundaries.

SearchWoot launch-readiness remains blocked and private. Progress is 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced closed. Data-use decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing evidence and smallest next actions: attach a dated source-rights matrix and prepare, but do not send, a counsel-reviewed permission request; produce the read-only alert data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent, withdrawal, GA4 property, data-sharing, and retention settings without enabling tracking; inventory log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and deletion/correction/request workflows. Keep outreach unsent and the private gate unchanged. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, notification, vendor, and future affiliate or advertising questions.

No go-live proposal is supportable. The launch-readiness rule requires every applicable data-use item to have a Legal disposition, material uncertainty escalated to human counsel, and technical, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates complete. Current non-legal gates remain blocked; fleet security is evidence_needed because fleet-doctor and operations results are absent. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it does not add credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, configuration, tracking, or cross-site behavior.
